name: nyc-yellow-taxi
title: NYC TLC yellow taxi trips, January 2026
description: Every yellow taxi trip the New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission recorded for January 2026, as the TLC publishes the month: when and where each trip began and ended, its distance and passengers, and its fare. The start reads the TLC's own file each time it is first opened, about 64 MB.

licenses.title: Published by the NYC Taxi and Limousine Commission as open data, under the City of New York's terms of use

sources.title: NYC Taxi and Limousine Commission, TLC Trip Record Data, yellow taxi trips, January 2026

fields.name: tpep_pickup_datetime
fields.description: When the meter was engaged, New York local time.

fields.name: trip_distance
fields.description: Miles, as the taximeter reported them.

fields.name: PULocationID
fields.description: The TLC taxi zone the trip began in: 132 is JFK Airport, 138 LaGuardia Airport and 1 Newark Airport in the TLC's zone lookup.

fields.name: passenger_count
fields.description: Passengers, as the driver entered them; missing on the trips with payment type 0.

fields.name: total_amount
fields.description: The total charged, in dollars; negative on refunds and voids.
